description: Calculate CO2e for one activity from a published factor. $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/emissions/calculate.

factor_id.description: string (required) - factor id from GET /toll/emissions/factors (base id or full record id incl. vintage)

quantity.description: number (required) - activity quantity in the factor's unit (must be > 0)

year.description: integer - optional activity year selecting the factor vintage; omitted = latest vintage, disclosed in the answer

name: emissions_calculate
